slot.brief: Ask which ligands are weak-field vs strong-field from the spectrochemical series, or the colour/magnetic nature a given series implies

stem: Among the following ligands, which produces the largest crystal-field splitting?

verdicts.working: In the spectrochemical series, ligand-field strength increases roughly as Br⁻ < H₂O < NH₃ < CO. Thus CO produces the largest splitting.

working:
Spectrochemical series: $\text{Br}^- < \text{H}_2\text{O} < \text{NH}_3 < \text{CO}$.

Independent check: In the spectrochemical series, ligand-field strength increases roughly as Br⁻ < H₂O < NH₃ < CO. Thus CO produces the largest splitting.
solution: From the spectrochemical series, ligand strength increases as $\text{Br}^- < \text{H}_2\text{O} < \text{NH}_3 < \text{CO}$. Hence, $\text{CO}$ produces the largest crystal-field splitting.
